summary: First-finish smoke test of BidifyX marketplace. Backend auth (email/password), buyer flow (post demand, view offers, accept offer), seller flow (browse demands, submit offer, my-offers, subscription status), admin (stats, users), and public products endpoints all return 200 with correct data. Frontend landing, login, buyer dashboard, post-demand page, and public product catalog all render and integrate with backend via httpOnly cookies. One real bug found: Stripe checkout fails for the Basic plan because PKR 100 (~$0.36) is below Stripe's 50-cent minimum charge; Pro (PKR 300) and Agency (PKR 1000) checkouts succeed and return a valid Stripe URL. Google OAuth and Stripe webhook were not exercised (external dependencies).
passed: POST /api/auth/login for buyer/seller/admin returns 200 + sets cookie
GET /api/auth/me returns authenticated user via cookie
GET /api/products returns 4 seeded products; GET /api/products/{slug} returns details
GET /api/buyer/demands and GET /api/buyer/demands/{id}/offers (returns offer + seller incl. verified+trust_score)
GET /api/seller/demands (open demands) returns enriched list with product_name
Frontend: landing, /login, /buyer/dashboard (shows stats + demand card), /buyer/post-demand (budget & duration inputs present), /products (4 cards) all load without console/UI errors
Buyer login E2E via UI redirects to /buyer/dashboard and shows Total Demands=1, Total Offers Received=1 from seeded data

failed.issue: POST /api/seller/subscription/checkout?plan=basic returns 500. Stripe rejects amount with: 'The Checkout Session's total amount must convert to at least 50 cents. PKR 100.00 converts to approximately $0.36.' Pro and Agency plans work fine.
failed.evidence: /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.CheckoutError: Failed to create checkout session: ... ₨100.00 converts to approximately $0.36.

failed.issue: Spec mentioned /api/seller/demands/open but actual route is /api/seller/demands. Not a bug per se; frontend uses /seller/demands. Calling /open returns 404.

not_tested: Google OAuth flow (requires real Google session)
Stripe webhook end-to-end and post-payment subscription upgrade (requires completing Stripe Checkout in browser)
action_items: Fix Basic plan checkout: either raise PKR price above ~PKR 140 (>=50 USD cents), or charge in USD, or block Basic plan from Stripe and mark it as N/A. Currently the seller-facing 'Upgrade' button for Basic will fail with an error toast.
Optional: surface a friendlier error on the frontend if Stripe checkout returns 500.
